gitCommit.subject: Account: a requests list that cannot be read is not left loading
gitCommit.body:
Account: a requests list that cannot be read is not left loading

The screenshot matrix found the Owner's requests card of a pending,
suspended or not-started business showing "Loading…" for ever beside the
refusal: the list's read failed, the error was shown, and the empty list
still read as loading. A list that could not be read now shows only the
refusal. The server half (the list readable in every state, as asking is)
is the backend's own change.

Gates: typecheck; vitest 18 files / 296 tests (the new case fails on the
old page); build:preview.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
